business_problem: Wayfair needed to enrich a massive product catalog faster and make discovery more visual and personalized so customers could explore home styles without the friction of manual curation.
solution_summary: Wayfair uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Wayfair needed to enrich a massive product catalog faster and make discovery more visual and personalized so customers could explore home styles without the friction of manual curation. Gemini automatically categorizes products and powers multimodal discovery experiences that adapt as the customer expresses preferences, serving as the compute layer. Gemini platform hosts the product-enrichment and discovery workflows that support catalog curation and AI-assisted shopping, serving as the serving layer. Nano Banana helps customers visualize products and styles inside Wayfair’s AI-powered design experiences, serving as the compute layer. New product data enters Gemini-based enrichment flows in Gemini platform, the catalog is expanded with richer attributes, and customers then use multimodal AI experiences such as Muse, Discover, and Nano Banana visualizations to refine style choices and reach checkout.
